description: PowerShell runbook and function contracts verified by the same generated tests under Pester major version 6, for an estate that selects Pester 6.

supports.description: Script parameter names, types, mandatory flags, nullability, enum validation sets and parameter order under positional passing.
Function parameter contract inside a script module.

unsupported.reason: Dynamic parameters cannot be resolved from the AST.

proofLimits: The generated tests inspect the script AST; they do not execute the routine's business logic.
A pass under Pester 6 does not qualify Pester 5, and the reverse.

checks.claim: The generated Pester tests pass against the conforming runbook fixture and fail against the violating fixture under Pester major version 6.
